name: Blood Curse of Exposure
description:
When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you takes damage from an attack or spell, you can take a Reaction to temporarily weaken its resilience. Until the end of the target’s next turn, it loses Resistance to all the damage types dealt by the triggering attack or spell (including for that triggering effect).
	**Amplify**: The target instead loses Immunity to the damage types of the triggering attack or spell, but has Resistance to those damage types until the end of its next turn.
